name: Security Identification 41 Choice
definition: Choice between ISIN and an alternative format for the identification of a financial instrument. ISIN is the preferred format.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN). A numbering system designed by the United Nation's International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO). The ISIN is composed of a 2-character prefix representing the country of issue, followed by the national security number (if one exists), and a check digit. Each country has a national numbering agency that assigns ISIN numbers for securities in that country.

AlternativeInstrumentIdentification.name: Alternative Instrument Identification
AlternativeInstrumentIdentification.definition: Proprietary identification of a security assigned by an institution or organisation.

UniqueProductIdentifier.name: Unique Product Identifier
UniqueProductIdentifier.definition: Identification through a unique product identifier.

Basket.name: Basket
Basket.definition: Identification of constituents for a basket of indexes.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Indicates the index upon which the financial instrument is based.

IdentificationNotAvailable.name: Identification Not Available
IdentificationNotAvailable.definition: Indicates that underlying identification is not available.
